Shehata Antibody PSR Dataset (Novo Nordisk Preprocessing)
	


	
		
	
	
		Dataset Summary
	

This dataset contains 398 human antibody heavy chain variable domain (VH) sequences with PSR (Poly-Specificity Reagent) measurements, preprocessed according to the methodology described in Sakhnini et al. 2025 (Novo Nordisk & University of Cambridge).
